content: {"reasoning":"The PR-204 denial means the service isn't covered under this plan, consistent with lapsed eligibility - not a documentation or authorization issue, so appeal/records/retro-auth don't apply. A secondary payer exists with correct COB order, so the proper next step to collect the allowed amount is to bill the secondary payer. Billing the patient would only recover patient-share money, which doesn't count.","action":"bill_secondary"}
